newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia share trade stable, Unibanka touch higher.
newsitem.headline: Latvia share trade stable, Unibanka touch higher.

text.p: Share trade on the Latvian stock exchange was slightly higher on Wednesday as the market started a new system of trading three times a week.
Overall turnover was 46,907 lats, versus 43,980 lats yesterday. Unibanka climbed one santime to 2.10 lats and turned over 32,623 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet, the other official list share, traded 2,070 lats and rose to 90 santimes from 89.
Activity was good on the secondary list, led by 3,400 lats trade in the Kaija fish cannery, which climbed to 85 santimes from 74 santimes.
Mangali Shipyard saw a healthy 3,200 lats of trade and rose to 32 santimes from 30.
The Riga Yeast plant turned over 2,550 lats and was stable at 85 santimes while the Daugavpils machine chain factory had trade of 2,546 lats but lost one santime to 34 santimes.
